meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 安装后,每当成功执行 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑操作,AI 会收到评论检查器自动生成的反馈;若发现警告,会暂停操作并修复或解释被标记的注释。
howto.when: 当成功执行 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑操作后触发,用于处理随之产生的自动评论检查反馈;非编辑工具不会触发。

say.text: 请修复刚才编辑中评论检查器标记的注释。
say.note: AI 会先修复或解释再继续。

say.text: 这个评论检查器警告是什么意思?
请说明为何可以忽略这条警告。
say.note: AI 会给出依据并继续。

howto.what_en: After installation, whenever edit operations like apply_patch, write, edit succeed, the AI receives automatic comment-checker feedback; if a warning is reported, it pauses and fixes or explains the flagged comment before continuing.
howto.when_en: Triggered after successful edit operations such as apply_patch, write, edit, to handle automatic comment-checker feedback; non-edit tools are ignored.

say_en.text: Please fix the comment flagged by the checker in the last edit.
say_en.note: AI will fix or explain before continuing.

say_en.text: What does this comment-checker warning mean?
Please explain why this warning can be ignored.
